N62 Light: an orange Enter (R842, the owner's K7; R843 builds the pick)

Four Enters on N62 Light's keypad at 360 px, each at rest and with Shift armed, so Enter stands beside Shift's orange in both states. Dark keeps its teal Enter (orange there is armed Shift). Shift's orange as drawn in Light is #5b2400 (R140 moved the family's #a03f00 away from Alpha's teal). Floors: Enter's fill ≥ 3:1 against every key next to it and the pad's ground (WCAG 1.4.11), its label ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 7:1 in High contrast), and ≥ 0.12 from Shift (app/scripts/cvd.ts, the smallest of normal vision and the three colour-vision deficiencies; theme-gen's Shift-to-Alpha floor), else the candidate is marked "reads as Shift". Below marks a missed floor. The numbers are node tools/probes/enter-orange.ts.

--key-enter: #529997 (OKLCH 0.636 0.072 193°), label #000000. N62's Enter in both brightnesses (R153).

Every candidate in High contrast (numbers)

Shift is #913900 here, the keys round Enter #eff9f8 and #f8fdfd. Fill: the smallest against them and the ground.

Enterfilllabelfill vs keysfrom Shift
Today #57a3a1#000000 7.16:12.73:10.226 (deuteranopia)
A #e17b00#000000 7.03:12.78:10.225 (tritanopia)
B #864a05#ffffff 7.01:16.54:10.009: reads as Shift (deuteranopia)
C #fb6800#000000 7.08:12.76:10.206 (protanopia)

Reading the page

  • Today: the logo's teal, the same Enter as Dark; its fill stands 2.75–3.09:1 from the keys round it and the ground, under the 3:1 floor already.
  • A is sandra's candidate; B is the deepest step: a white label at 4.5:1 on A's hue; C lies between them in lightness and is the most vivid orange that meets every floor.
  • Shift armed follows R729 (not merged yet): Shift's legends get a ring in Shift's orange, the faces and letters dim, the Shift key is ringed; Enter's ≈ is ringed in its own label colour.
  • The prefix cells of the unit pad take a little of Enter's colour (theme-gen's --key-pfx); an orange Enter tints them peach. R843 keeps or changes that.
  • The choice: A, B, C or none (Enter stays teal). R843 starts on the answer.
